attorneys: Acting Solicitor General Spritzer on the motion.

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. Tex. (Certiorari granted, 388 U. S. 905.) Motion of Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument, as amicus curiae, granted and thirty minutes allotted for that purpose. Counsel for respondents allotted an additional thirty minutes for oral argument.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
